evidence.excerpt: We introduce RTLReviewBench, a benchmark of 114 matched pairs of buggy and correct Verilog modules.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Synthetic mutants hide part of the problem: on the same designs, models miss far fewer injected bugs than real ones.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Evaluating 12 commercial and open-weight models, we find a consistent asymmetry: reviewers rarely accept buggy code but often reject correct code, producing more than five false rejections for every missed bug.
